items.label: Fridge surround and overhead cupboard
items.observation: Homeowner supplied inspiration for wood side panels and a cupboard above the fridge. This is not a reference measurement or photograph of the modeled home.

items.label: Open appliance platforms
items.observation: Cropped homeowner supplied screenshot showing appliances on open pull-out platforms. The proposed cabinet above the washer/dryer is independently supported; platforms are shown retracted in 3D.

items.label: Castlery Vincent walnut dining inspiration
items.observation: Homeowner supplied a six-seat styled reference and selected the 150 cm Vincent table with matching dark upholstered chairs. Castlery lists the selected table as 150 W × 80 D × 76 H cm, seating four comfortably. The model uses four photo-inspired chairs; their dimensions remain estimated. The rug, pendant and sideboard in this image are not part of the requested table replacement.

items.label: Solange Chalk Boucle chair in White Wash
items.observation: Homeowner selected two chairs. Castlery SKU 54000102-CB4001 gives 68 W × 77 D × 75 H cm and 42 cm seat height. Cushion shape, boucle texture and timber grain are modeled approximations.

items.label: Veronica Sand concrete round coffee table
items.observation: Homeowner selected Sand. HipVan SKU 185648 gives 70 cm diameter × 34 cm high. Rounded underside and pedestal proportions follow the Sand image; some page copy inconsistently says Black.

items.label: Omnidesk Classic Wildwood Small, Pheasantwood and black frame
items.observation: Homeowner selected the Small desk in the supplied configured URL: 122 × 76 cm, Pheasantwood top and black Classic frame. The official product page gives a 74–121 cm height range; the model is shown at 74 cm. Wood grain, 26 mm top thickness, monitor and ergonomic chair details are illustrative. The room becomes a two-person office; the bed is removed and the built-in wardrobe stays in place at the homeowner’s explicit request.

items.label: LG Styler S3MFC, Essence Mirrored Finish
items.observation: Homeowner selected this product for placement beside the master-bedroom wardrobe. LG Singapore specifies 445 W × 1850 H × 585 D mm, Essence Mirrored Finish and touch controls. The closed exterior and mirror appearance are illustrative; the physical product dimensions are retained.

items.label: Three-blade metal directional fan inspiration
items.observation: Homeowner selected Image #1 style for the kitchen entrance position. Brand, exact model and dimensions are unconfirmed. The rendered 300 mm blade sweep and nominal 450 mm drop are illustrative.
